title: Agenda
text_runs: NOTE: Look at the whole deck and fill out what should be here. There should also be something here about how this isn’t a sales pitch– our goal is to get you thinking about opportunities you might have in your own practices to develop reusable tools and workflows, and we’re demonstrating how we’ve done that internally by way of example.
